title: Fragment XV. Maximus the Confessor, scholia on Dionysius c. 2

segments.text: Those who practised guilelessness towards God they used to call children, as Papias also shows in the first book of the Expositions of the Lord, and Clement of Alexandria in the Paedagogue.
Maximus the Confessor, Schol. in libr. Dionys. Areopag. de eccl. hierarch. c. 2.
